models.label: Mendoza 2011 NRSHM, primary (dE, low-j; published constants, not refit)

notes: In-sample block: fitted models are their all-data fits; Z>=55 there is NOT the blind test.
Held-out block: fitted models copied from the validation files (refit per split). For parameter-free and not-refit models the split cells are MAPEs on the same test rows; nothing is held out.

Mendoza 2011 constants were GA-fitted by its authors to NIST+FAC data for He- to Eu-like sequences (with an extension to Z = 68-92), excluding neutral atoms and first ions: its split cells are subsets, not blind tests.

Mendoza 2011 constants (models/benchmarks/mendoza2011/constants.json): all 361 entries were compared on 2026-10-06 with the text layer of the deposited article (https://oa.upm.es/11165/2/INVE_MEM_2011_102088.pdf, Tables 1-2): 0 mismatches (see docs/review/claims_and_matrix.md).
LSDA dSCF covers 207 rows (all ions Z<=18 + neutral Z=19-54); no Z>=55 rows; no selection score.
The pocket formula's V1 (4.4e6, 'fit diverges') is optimizer-path dependent: it converges to 4.35 % on the Python 3.11 / NumPy 2.4 / SciPy 1.17 stack (docs/review/reproducibility_py311.md).
